features.name: to appear unexpectedly
features.native_xml:
<roleset id="crop.02" name="to appear unexpectedly" vncls="-">
<roles>
  <role descr="entity cropped" n="1" />
</roles>


<example name="intransitive">
<inflection aspect="ns" form="full" person="ns" tense="future" voice="active" />
<text>
 Hugh Johnson , chief investment officer at First Albany Corp. , agreed that a deteriorating economy is worrisome , but he said [0] the real concern among stock investors is that some new problem will crop up in the junk bond market .
</text>
	<arg n="0">some new problem</arg>
	<arg f="MOD" n="M">will</arg>
	<rel>[ crop] [ up]</rel>
	<arg f="LOC" n="M">in the junk bond market</arg>
</example>

</roleset>

<roleset id="crop.01" name="to cut" vncls="-">
<roles>
  <role descr="cutter, agent" n="0" />
  <role descr="entity cropped" n="1" />
  <role descr="extend" n="2" />
  <role descr="start point" n="3" />
  <role descr="end point" n="4" />
</roles>

<example name="with four arguments">
<inflection aspect="ns" form="full" person="ns" tense="past" voice="active" />
<text>
 Yet yesterday 's market cropped Dresdner 's share price by 33 marks to 309 marks a share , [*] leaving little incentive for investors to subscribe to the standing price unless the market recovers quickly .
</text>
	<arg f="DIS" n="M">Yet</arg>
	<arg n="0">yesterday 's market</arg>
	<rel>cropped</rel>
	<arg n="1">Dresdner 's share price</arg>
	<arg f="EXT" n="2">by 33 marks</arg>
	<arg f="to" n="4">309 marks a share</arg>
	<arg f="ADV" n="M">[*] leaving little incentive for investors to subscribe to the standing price unless the market recovers quickly</arg>
</example>
</roleset>

rulings.rationale: The exact native noun defines the kidney as one of two bean-shaped excretory organs and describes their bodily filtration function. The organ is the defining entity, so BODY=+1 follows from its own meaning.

warrant.statement: Every inspected native WordNet 3.0 sense in the internal_organ.n.01 branch defines an animal anatomical organ, a part or group of organs, or a named physical enlargement of an organ. The bodily structure is constitutive of each meaning. This includes mollusk respiration, the ruminant stomach compartments, and external gills within WordNet's branch. Branch membership does not assert that each organ lies inside the body. Exact noun identity, witnessed ancestry, and an attested native spelling are all required. A native in-scope definition lacking its own bodily component falsifies this law. Same-spelling pumps, crop yields, punctuation, currency and geographic meanings remain outside the guard. Derived spellings require separate identity evidence. The rule assigns only BODY=+1 and requires a separate withheld-answer model audit.
